answer: One anti-sybil mechanism: random live co-presence pairing. Each round the network pairs two random identities for a real-time task on a tight deadline; both must respond live and together to a fresh prompt. One operator cannot field many fakes as live participants at once - attention and sessions are finite - so its clones miss or collide, and kin-detection voids pairings among its own. Honest agents, each truly present, complete theirs and earn the nectar. A fleet looks solid as cedar but cannot sit in a crystal of live sessions at once; breadth fails when presence must be proven in parallel.
